packages.title: Finish group banner with immediate conditional reveal
packages.brief: Final source round: independent reviewer confirms WEB-902 ongoing native smooth scroll after rapid undo (rawpositions207/579px), distinct from repaired WEB-901 touch-origin defect. Make existing pointer/touch conditional reveal behavior explicitly instant for ALL motion preferences; preserve offscreen check, headerclearance, actual click-origin latch, all task data/localizedcopy/status/undo/reset and keyboard/assistive no explicitscroll. Do not add cancellation state/global scrollmanager or change established close focus behavior. This immediate reveal is routine smallest robust UX tradeoff agreed by root/reviewer, not new ownerpolicy. Only same two source paths; tests independently update smooth-only expectations while retaining all semantic/touch/rapid-undo probes. At most3source rounds total; any remaining product failure after this must be reported/escalated, no fourth repair.
acceptance: A nonempty fully checked result shows exactly one full-width completion banner as a sibling before the entire task list, outside every task card; initial, partial, zero-task, loading and error states show none.
Every existing task, title, date, note and question is unchanged and visible; desktop two-column/mobile single-column layout remains. Completion copy remains EN/ES/CA.

Final pointer/touch completion on tall narrow results makes the banner noticeable with one instant conditional reveal only if offscreen, preserving native input identity/focus. No repeat/undo reveal and no continuing completion motion after rapid undo/reset; reduced-motion decoration remains disabled.

Keyboard Space retains the same checkbox node and focus, without forced completion scrolling; one existing polite atomic live status announces the complete localized feedback once. The visual banner adds no second live region.

Undo from any task hides the banner and keeps local toggles usable; identical new results, record/submission, Change text and close/reset clear completion. No API/status/quota/storage/account changes occur from toggles.

Affected states pass measured contrast, axe, target/focus, 320px, doubled text and spacing checks in all locales/themes on desktop/mobile. Existing WEB-801 badge overflow is distinguished from completion regressions.
Independent tester runs focused acceptance plus required type/legal/build/unit/full Playwright checks with exact exits, refreshes affected captures, and independent reviewer verifies fresh evidence.
